item.title: ELICOS Market Analysis: October 2025
item.description: The report offers insights into how the sector is changing in response to the many interventions of government over the last two years. Read more here.

item.title: December PD Update
item.description: Click here for English Australia's December PD Update featuring all you need to improve your skills in 2026 with English Australia. Thank you for a wonderful 2025, we very much look forward to many rewarding professional development opportunities in the year to come!

item.title: Call for EOIs to present at Qld PD Fest
item.description: We’re delighted to announce that the 2026 English Australia QLD PD Fest will take place in March 2026 at UQ College. We are now inviting abstract submissions from educators and professionals interested in presenting at QLD PD Fest. Read more here.

item.title: January PD Update
item.description: We’re excited to launch our Professional Development program for 2026, beginning in early February with a hands-on webinar on Teaching Mixed-level Classes, presented by Circular Learning. State PD Fests will bring practitioners together across the country, and we’re currently developing a series of national workshops tailored specifically for Student Services Teams. Click here for the full update!

item.title: Changes to the National Code
item.description: An amendment to the National Code, signed by Assistant Minister Julian Hill, was published and became effective on 20 January. The amendment alters Standard 4 of the National Code and introduces the much-anticipated restriction on education agent commissions for transferring students. Read more

item.title: March PD Update
item.description: Click here for English Australia's March PD Update featuring a range of professional learning opportunities; from hands-on workshops with Duolingo to webinars on Reading Lessons and Exploiting Course Resources. Take a look at what’s on offer, register for an event, and consider sharing your own insights with the sector at a PD Fest.

item.title: Call for Abstracts – English Australia Conference 2026
item.description: Abstract submissions are now open for the English Australia Conference 2026. This year’s theme, “Stories of Transformation seeks to share stories of the life-changing impact of ELICOS, explore innovative approaches and emerging models of ELICOS delivery, and highlight the vital role our sector plays within Australia’s broader international education landscape. Submissions close 12 May 2026. Learn more here.

item.title: Nominations for English Australia Awards now open!
item.description: Nominations are now open for the 2026 English Australia Awards. This is your opportunity to recognise those who form an integral part of a community that values excellence and leadership! Read more and nominate here.
